decisions.reason: Explains sibling imports resolve against the entry chunk URL, siblings were never shipped so the graph fetch fails despite entry 200, and proposes a self-contained single-file build with inlineDynamicImports.

Identifies uppercase E: LIB_DIR vs lowercase e: realpath, case-sensitive startsWith rejecting a contained file; explains Linux byte-identical prefix and laptop case agreement; explicitly rejects the 'Windows paths unreliable' claim and notes realpath case is host-dependent, not always lowercase.

Canonicalizes both sides via realpathSync, uses path.relative rejecting '' , '..', '..'-prefixed and absolute results, keeps realpath symlink-escape check, and preserves a JavaScript MIME type for dynamic import.

Explains wheel bubbling delivering one gesture to both pane and modal handlers; grants the modal exclusive ownership with preventDefault plus stopPropagation and has the pane handler stand down via composedPath/target checks.

Planned checks with expected outcomes for all three incidents: build/pack assertions plus no-404, no-code-block-fallback smoke; case-mismatched Windows path must serve while traversal and symlink escape stay 403; modal Ctrl+wheel zooms with pane font unchanged, plus over-blocking guard.

caps.reason: The proposed fix keeps and strengthens containment; no advice serves paths outside the plugin root.
